findings.current: “Don’t tell me he made it into the inner palace.”
findings.defect: “Inner palace” specifies a distinct part of the palace that the source does not name.
findings.rationale: Baek Yeon asks whether the intruder entered the palace, not whether he reached an inner-palace precinct.
findings.replacement: “Don’t tell me he got inside the palace.”
findings.source: 설마 궁 안까지 발을 디딘 것은 아니겠지.

findings.current: the silhouette of someone in dazzling white showed through the thin curtains.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the person is seen from behind.
findings.rationale: 뒷모습 specifically identifies a view of the person’s back.
findings.replacement: the back of a figure dressed in dazzling white showed through the thin curtains.
findings.source: 얇은 비단 사이로 눈부신 백의(白衣)를 걸친 누군가의 뒷모습이 비쳤다.

findings.current: “Please don’t forget the promise you made that day.”
findings.defect: The draft assigns the promise solely to the Emperor, though the source leaves who made it unstated.
findings.rationale: 그날의 약조 identifies the promise by its occasion, without specifying its maker.
findings.replacement: “Please don’t forget the promise from that day.”

findings.current: The Son of Heaven muttered with a scornful laugh.
findings.defect: “Scornful” adds contempt to the Emperor’s reaction.
findings.rationale: 실소 suggests an involuntary or incredulous laugh here, not necessarily scorn.
findings.replacement: The Son of Heaven muttered with a short, incredulous laugh.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it changes one location detail and loses or adds several meaningful cues.
